item.title: Dareka no Tame ni Dekiru Koto ~Innocent Identity~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fermi
  • 発売日: 2009-02-27
  • スコア: 6.09/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 誰かのために出来ること～Innocent Identity～
  • 英語名: Dareka no Tame ni Dekiru Koto Innocent Identity

あらすじ

A boring life. Takaya always thinks, “I hope something interesting happens…” One day, a girl transfers to his class. Her name is Aya and she came from a small town in the country. Also, she starts living at an apartment Takaya takes care of. Her presence is a symbol of changing life. Aya is always cheerful and his school life gradually changes. “Is this my school life I wanted?” Because of Aya’s innocent behaviors, he also gets to know different characters of his classmates. Yes, this is just the beginning of his new school life.
